set.body:
Owner: fit/profile numerical laws. Required P1 follow-up to PHRF-07; keep its backend implementation credited. Depends on PHRF-07 and PHRF-04, both implemented. Source: modules/first-level-laws/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/fmri/laws/profile/TrialBandedSuite.scala; add small shared law fixtures/helpers as needed without a second production solver.

Problem and exact reproduction:
TrialBandedSuite.scala:173 permutes a fixture originally using two 60-row runs, but resets all block IDs to zero and replaces the frame with one 120-row run. It compares that new experiment with its own dense oracle. This does not test trial-permutation invariance. Existing trial backend laws use a two-parameter Gaussian family while the B0 workload uses three-parameter Cascade34.

Acceptance:
1. Permute complete trial records (onset, duration, run ID, membership and trial identity) together, preserve the two-run frame and response/nuisance/whitening geometry, and compare original vs permuted energies, condition means, gradients, full Hessians and constrained determinant at identical shapes. Undo the permutation on trial amplitudes and query weights before comparison. Dense-oracle parity is additional evidence, not the metamorphic assertion.
2. Include cross-run/interleaved trial order, coincident trials and unequal/singleton conditions. Show bandwidth may change under ordering without changing results. Add condition-axis permutation and signed-query/sign-reversal cases where supported; do not silently alter the estimand.
3. Add a small genuinely 3D Cascade34 fixture with off-grid interior shapes. Compare solves, profiled energy, condition/trial amplitudes, all first derivatives and six unique second derivatives against independent dense augmented equations / finite-difference step sweeps. Compare constrained ML determinant against a full-data covariance oracle. Include rho=0 tail-coordinate nonidentification explicitly rather than treating it as ordinary positive curvature.
4. Cover no whitening and shared AR whitening with exact run resets, and the declared lambda extremes 1e-6 and 1e4 with tolerances justified by conditioning/scale. Record what the oracle shares with production lowering/family/whitening; do not claim independent upstream convolution proof.
5. Promote the cases to ordinary shared MUnit laws on JVM and JS with deterministic bounded fixtures. Avoid mirroring packed assembly in the oracle. A planted wrong run ID/permutation mapping or omitted mixed-derivative term should be detected by the relevant assertions; record the sensitivity check without requiring a new mutation framework.
6. Run TrialBandedSuite and provider/reduction laws on both platforms, then warning-clean scalafimCompileAll. Record exact revisions and counts. Update PHRF-07 evidence to identify its true coverage and link these new regressions.

Closure is a numerical-law repair, not decoder integration, B0 throughput or scientific calibration. PHRF-29 and PHRF-33 consume this evidence.
set.title: PHRF-32: Repair TrialBanded permutation laws and add three-dimensional Cascade34 parity
